# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Applied the review follow-ups by correcting `docs/UNITS.md` so helper work stays scoped to `tanksim-6e5.2.2` while kinetics/parameter renames move to the downstream normalization beads, clarifying the startup TUI label from ambiguous "Water volume" to "Filled volume", and refactoring affected tests to use canonical net-water and concentration helpers (`TankState::water_volume_l()`, `tan_mg_n_per_l()`, `nitrite_mg_n_per_l()`, `gh_d()`, `do_mg_per_l()`) instead of recomputing concentrations from gross geometry volume.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the approved validation findings and identified the actionable follow-ups: stale bead references in `docs/UNITS.md`, ambiguous startup volume labeling, and tests still bypassing the canonical helper layer.
1. [Completed] Updated `docs/UNITS.md` to assign helper work to `tanksim-6e5.2.2` and concentration-based kinetics renames to the downstream nitrification, plant, and algae beads, and adjusted the TUI startup copy to label gross geometry volume as filled volume.
2. [Completed] Refactored the affected tests to initialize chemistry against `TankState::water_volume_l()` and to assert concentrations via canonical helper APIs instead of dividing raw totals by `geometry.water_volume_l()`.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting and workspace tests to verify the follow-up edits and re-checked that only intentional gross-volume assertions still call `geometry.water_volume_l()` in tests.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
- A follow-up `rg` scan shows remaining `geometry.water_volume_l()` calls in tests are limited to intentional gross-volume assertions in scenario materialization, tank-size geometry checks, and concentration-helper regression coverage.
- No `.beads/` files changed in this stage, so `br lint` was not required.

## Outstanding Risks

- Kinetic normalization and half-saturation parameter renames are still deferred to `tanksim-6e5.2.3`, `tanksim-6e5.2.4`, and `tanksim-6e5.2.5`; this stage only aligned docs/tests/UI with the helper layer.
- `TankGeometry::water_volume_l()` still intentionally exposes gross filled-prism volume for geometry-facing contexts, so future chemistry or exposure code must continue to prefer `TankState::water_volume_l()` for net-water semantics.
